head.t: Tech2Walk campaign launches in Parliament for fairer NHS access to advanced orthotics
head.x: Campaign launched in Parliament on 17 November, sponsored by Luke Taylor MP, calling for a funded NHS pilot and then a national commissioning pathway for advanced knee-ankle-foot orthoses, saying access depends on ability to pay. Blatchford, Ossur and Ottobock attended.

head.t: Framework ending 8 June 2027: Wheelchairs, Specialist Seating and Related Services
head.x: Named on NHS Supply Chain's own contract launch brief for this framework, as "Blatchford Limited" (Lot 1, Lot 2). 31 suppliers on the framework.
